collection_notes: Both existing status examples were loaded with ?case=normalization. Each of the two input/result JSON roots was collapsed once through its observed UI caret; no application parameters were changed after initial load and no extra server rerun was requested.

PageDown, End and Home were actual keyboard input on main. DOM geometry is retained before and after each stage; only comparison adds scrollTop to y and subtracts the first alert x. Raw coordinates and viewport heights remain unchanged in the record.

The initial Python viewport height was 1305 versus Rust 1249. Subsequent retained states use 1249 on both; corresponding scroll max changes from 2844 to 2900 without alert content/size changes. No viewport override or system/browser setting was changed.

Screenshots use the supported tab CDP Page.captureScreenshot after activating only the owned tab and moving the pointer away from controls. Top/bottom images were visually inspected. No screenshot timeout occurred in this batch.

Literal U+001C remains in the measured emoji-separator body and can appear as a missing/control glyph in the screenshot, matching the Python reference. This is compatibility evidence, not a claim of general control-character sanitization.
This validates fixed-input initial rendering and scrolling, not callback behavior, parameter-update identity, arbitrary themes/viewports or illegal icon/error combinations.
